title: The Skiff North
description: While Kindleby's chapter sat, two sisters ran the chapter's skiff down the shingle and rowed north into the fog with oil, meal and a lantern, for the colliers you said were waiting on the Northing's boat-stage. The Provost sent it to bring back whoever wants bringing.

stages.text: Kindleby's skiff has gone north round the islands to the Keepers' boat-stage under the Northing's cliff on Thornwold. Go down the Keepers' steps to the far shore and see it in.

Kindleby's skiff is tied up at the Northing's boat-stage, the first boat at that ring since the Snuffing. Sister Hild Garrow will take back whoever wants bringing. Wenna Coll sat on that stage counting days for a boat; now there's one, she wants somebody to tell her what to do. Tell her.
